explication: Dash to Panel is a GNOME Shell extension that combines launchers, running applications, and system controls in a configurable panel. The main runtime path initializes settings and a panel manager, which creates per-monitor panels and taskbars; taskbar icons support app/window actions and previews. Additional branches implement overview shortcuts, intelligent hiding, transparency, and desktop-icon integration. Paths and edges are limited to the supplied tree, README statements, and source references; unsampled feature wiring is represented only where documented.
